<!--
Thanks for the pull request! Please help the reviewer by filling in
the sections below. Delete anything that doesn't apply.
-->

## Summary

What does this PR change, and why? Link the related issue if any
(e.g. `Fixes #123`).

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change (API, chart values, or CLI flag change)
- [ ] Refactor (no behaviour change)
- [ ] Docs only
- [ ] CI / build only

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the DCO
- [ ] `make test` passes locally
- [ ] Docs / README / chart values comments updated where relevant
- [ ] Proto changes (if any) keep backwards compatibility, or the PR
      description explains the migration

## How to test

Reproducible steps, kubectl output, or screenshots that show the
change working. Include any commands the reviewer should run to verify.

## Additional notes

Anything a reviewer should know that isn't obvious from the diff.
